headline: Mayor proclaims October 20, 2017 as Community Media Day

meeting.body: Mayor Arakawa Proclaims Community Media Day on Maui
meeting.summary: The mayor proclaimed October 20th, 2017 as Community Media Day throughout Maui County.
meeting.recap: The mayor of the County of Maui proclaimed October 20th, 2017 as Community Media Day throughout Maui County.[[0:00:00]] He encouraged all people to promote the importance of community media.[[0:00:08]] He said media training is available at the county's community media center.[[0:00:16]] He said public programming is available for everyone on Spectrum Cable channels 53, 54, and 55.[[0:00:18]] He urged people to go to the studios and take classes to learn to direct and use the studio equipment.[[0:00:30]] He said this lets people bring their message to the rest of the community.[[0:00:44]] He congratulated the community media center on a great job.[[0:00:50]]
decided: The mayor proclaimed October 20th, 2017 as Community Media Day throughout Maui County; no vote was taken.

moments.q: Mayor reads the Community Media Day proclamation
"I cannot stress how important it is to be able to actually go to the studios"
